Bill.BriefDescription: Relating to an education master plan.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a master plan for education prekindergartenthrough university; and creating new sections.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Research suggests that creating a moreintegrated, seamless education system involves a host of complexissues, including standards, testing, educator preparation, collegeadmissions policies, governance, and funding streams. Over the pastdecade, a number of states have begun to move away from dealing withsuch issues on a piecemeal basis in favor of a more comprehensiveapproach. Commonly referred to as P16 or P20, these comprehensivestate programs reflect the central vision of a coherent, flexiblecontinuum of public education that stretches from preschool through thebaccalaureate degree or beyond.
This act shall be known as the master planfor education act of 2003.
